items.title: Static image

items.title: ALL
items.description: Run ALL for one selected building/root: SQFT, Walls, Gables, Truss Heel, Parapet, Eve/Rakes, Openings, then framing floors and shifted Headers

items.title: Legend (LG)
items.description: Open the job-specific legend used by Beams, Posts, and Headers. ALL also exports framing floors.

items.title: SQFT (SF)
items.description: SQFT: append to J:L, select J:K, run A2_SQFT_calc

items.title: Walls (WL)
items.description: Walls: run A3, preserve mandatory A:H output rows, then delete zero rows

items.title: Gables (GB)
items.description: Gables: append to J:L, select J:K, run A2_SQFT_calc

items.title: Truss Heel (TH)
items.description: Truss Heel: append to J:L, select J:K, run A2_SQFT_calc

items.title: Parapet (PP)
items.description: Parapet: append to J:L, select J:K, run A4_Parapet

items.title: Eve/Rakes (E/R)
items.description: Eve/Rakes: Eve by LF descending, then Rake by LF descending; run A6_Eve_Rakes

items.title: Openings (OP)
items.description: Openings: append from Z158, run C_SumNearWindowValues per floor, then A5_Openings

items.title: Sheathing (SH)
items.description: Sheathing: run A7_walls_sheathing with the Zip / Ply / OSB text of column J (or 'wall sheathing = ...' from the LG legend); it keeps one sheathing system and removes the other rows. Runs after Walls in ALL.

items.title: Shear walls (SW)
items.description: Shear walls: stage shear walls/<floor>/shear and holdowns in J:L, fill the Shear Walls row (interior walls, ext walls use the wall sheathing) and one Holdowns row per holdown in each floor's walls block.

items.title: Shaft walls (SHF)
items.description: Shaft walls: stage the shaft wall lines and add (or update) the Shaft walls block above the first framing list: panels, CH and J channels from LF x wall height.

items.title: Units (UN)
items.description: Units: build the units table (Mark x 2x4/2x6/half sizes, per-floor counts and SUMPRODUCT totals) at the anchor set in Settings (AM3) from units/<Mark size> lines and units/<floor>/<Mark> counts.

items.title: Balconies (BL)
items.description: Balconies: one '#n Upper Balcony/Terrace List W' x L' N units' block per balcony size (and '#n Porch Framing List' per porch size) from SQFT areas named blcny / balcony / porch, copied from the template's #1 block.

items.title: Framing (FR)
items.description: Framing ALL for the selected building: posts, beams and joists replace their rows in each floor framing list (other template rows stay), headers go to the wall block one floor down, details are staged in J:L. A missing list (6th floor, balcony) is added.

items.title: Posts (PS)
items.description: Posts: replace the Posts rows in each framing list of the selected building. Uses the LG legend for sizes.

items.title: Beams (BM)
items.description: Beams: replace the Beam rows in each framing list of the selected building. Uses the LG legend for sizes.

items.title: Headers (HD)
items.description: Headers: rebuild the header rows of the wall block one floor below each framing floor; Wall Sheathing and the rows after it stay.

items.title: Joists (JS)
items.description: Joists: replace the Joist rows in each framing list; Extra joists of the same length join the row and short joists go on double stock (Settings).

items.title: Details (DT)
items.description: Details: stage the detail lines of each floor in J:L under a label row, once. A group already staged is left alone.

items.title: Stairs (ST)
items.description: Stairs: add the stair takeoffs before Subfloor of each framing list; a repeated export replaces them.
